verdict.rationale: DPMA runs online filing and register services (DPMAdirektWeb, DPMAdirektPro, DPMAregister) that handle user-submitted data, so data retention and deletion control is a fair privacy question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions retention periods, deletion requests, or any user control over stored data. The robots.txt probe only concerns crawling policy and says nothing about retention.
